answer.verdict: Controls config is in the owned pad path. Defaults reach the airport fight. Remapping S off Down fails the display step on the posted-key path. Tests 489/489/0. HUD input avg 20.8 ms. Controls section is in host_08s.png.

facts.c: Radial deadzone default is 0.15 on both sticks. triggerThreshold -1 means digital L2/R2. invert and swap default off. This deadzone is the only intentional change from the old no-deadzone sticks.
Port 0 bytes stay uint8 128+v*127 after clamp. Later ports still use axisToByte.
Port 0 reads publishedSnap, mapGamepad on pad 0, then sampleKeyboard. Suppressed posting skips keys. sampleKeyboard true ORs the mask and does not call IsKeyDown.
vkToPad and asyncPadMask read publishedSnap. While pad posting is suppressed, wndProc skips g_posted and sampleKeyboard returns true with mask 0.
attachWindow calls ps2_graphics::get before the hook. A settings file publishes the snap and logs cross_keys and circle_keys only after fopen succeeds.
fillSnap rewrites L2/R2 digital sources to trigger axes when threshold > 0, ORs vk masks, and aliases VK_SHIFT 0x10 to left shift.
Later ports call mapGamepad, swap, invertAndDeadzone. Keyboard preset sets ignoreGamepads so port>0 reports disconnected. Port 0 stays connected.

F2 Controls is first: preset combo, bind child 420x200, deadzone and trigger sliders, invert-right checkbox, swap, reset. Capture or ImGui text suppresses pad posting. Capture also blocks gamepad buttons. Hidden panel does not touch the gate.
